snippet.title: TerraLounge Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist TerraLounge and play the free demo on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5045050/

Match-3 meets desktop pet. Pop slimes, grow your collection, and keep them hanging out on your screen while you work, game, or wind down.

Every slime's got its own personality. They squish, they hop, they judge your bad swaps, and the more you play, the more you unlock for them.

Play the demo during Steam Next Fest, October 19–26. Full release November 5th.
